steps.title: Commit them to a new branch
steps.detail: Commits these files as the clone holds them now on the new branch edits/20260921-141320, from the commit the clone has checked out. The clone's checkout, index, and files stay as they are. The last command pushes the branch to origin.
commands: git branch edits/20260921-141320 "$(git commit-tree "$(git write-tree)" -p HEAD -m 'Commit files from a clone that ropeshift could not read')"

steps.title: Push the commits
steps.detail: Pushes main to origin, which holds no commit that changed these files yet. Git refuses a push that would drop the remote's commits.

steps.title: Copy them into the planning branch lane/lane-plan-1
steps.detail: Commits these files as the clone holds them now on the new branch edits/20260921-141320-lane-plan-1, from the tip of lane/lane-plan-1, which the planning lane lane-plan-1 works on, and tells the lane to merge it in its own worktree. Ropeshift never moves a branch a worktree has checked out.
commands: git update-index --add --remove -- docs/design.md 'plans/notes on retries.md' plans/retry.md &&
git branch edits/20260921-141320-lane-plan-1 "$(git commit-tree "$(git write-tree)" -p refs/heads/lane/lane-plan-1 -m 'Commit files from a clone that ropeshift could not read')"

ropeshift message send lane-plan-1 --project default --kind instruction --body 'Merge the branch edits/20260921-141320-lane-plan-1 into your branch in your own worktree. A member copied these files onto it from their clone of the planning repository: docs/design.md, plans/notes on retries.md, plans/retry.md.'
